Title: Azure App Configuration is now available in preview

Body.Content:
Azure App Configuration, a new Azure service, centrally manages application settings and helps secure their accesses. In addition, it helps developers ship code faster by being able to easily “flight” their features in production using feature flags.

To get started immediately, check out one of our five-minute quickstarts.

The service is currently available in six public Azure regions: East US, Central US, West Central US, West US, West Europe, and Southeast Asia. More regions will be added in the future.

Read our documentation to learn more.
